title: Submission Guidelines
desc: What a plugin needs to be accepted.
lede: Sharing an engine for others? Here's the bar it should meet.
body:
At a glance
  • Passes a security & safety review.
  • Is stable and performs reasonably.
  • Is self-contained and properly licensed.

Security & safety

Engines run code, so safety comes first. Respect the boundaries (no app imports, only write to allowed paths), and disclose any network use.

Stability & performance

It should work reliably and not hog resources. Declare an honest resource profile so scheduling can do its job.

Self-contained & licensed

Everything in the repo, with a clear license. Tests included, weights downloaded on first use, license stated in the manifest.
